description: The plot illustrates the performance of various fine-tuning configurations for a "tiny" Whisper model, tracking changes across training epochs. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and uses a linear scale with tick marks from 30 to 70 at intervals of 10. The plot contains five gray lines representing different configurations. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" configuration is depicted by a solid line with circle markers, starting at a WER of approximately 68.8 at epoch 0 and steadily declining to end at 36.2 at epoch 6. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" configuration is shown as a solid line with square markers, beginning at 59.8 at epoch 0, showing a minimal decrease between epochs 1 and 2 (51.2 to 50.8), and continuing to decline to a final value of 32.1 at epoch 6. The "tiny int4" configuration is represented by a dashed line with circle markers; it starts at 68.8 at epoch 0, decreases to 39.4 at epoch 4, remains steady at 39.4 at epoch 5, and slightly increases to end at 40.1 at epoch 6. The "tiny int8" configuration is a dashed line with square markers, starting at 59.8 at epoch 0, dropping to 46.7 at epoch 1, and gradually declining to end at 36.9 at epoch 6. Finally, the "tiny full" configuration is a dotted line with upward-pointing triangle markers, starting at a lower initial value of 28.8 at epoch 0, decreasing to 24.1 at epoch 3, remaining nearly flat to 24.0 at epoch 4, and ending at 22.9 at epoch 6.
